summary: Scope ActivityReadBatch worktree fence to inspected checkout

delivery.outcome: Fence only the inspected checkout's own worktree registration stanza and consulted ticket branch heads in ActivityReadBatch so concurrent sibling worktree allocations and commits do not trigger false-positive GOV-TICKET-ACTIVITY-001 aborts.
nonGoals: Do not weaken TOCTOU revalidation of the inspected checkout's HEAD, worktree registration, target refs, registry files, or consulted ticket branches.
Do not directly mutate consumer adopter repositories outside pinned governance upgrades.

architecture.decision: Extract the inspected root's own porcelain worktree stanza in ActivityReadBatch._worktree_registration() (falling back to full output only if root is not a top-level worktree entry) and revalidate for-each-ref branch heads strictly for ticket numbers consulted during the batch, keeping scripts/ticket_activity.py and bundled wellman _bundled/ticket_activity.py byte-identical.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded commit through an independently reviewed pull request.

validation.evidence: Sibling worktree commits and allocations no longer invalidate ActivityReadBatch, while mutating the inspected checkout's registration, HEAD, target ref, or consulted ticket branch still fails closed.
All overlap, ticket-activity, governance, and Wellman checks pass.
